verdict.rationale: The official Mercury CLI exposes an `--environment sandbox|production` flag, indicating a sandbox mode exists for testing without touching production data, but there is no first-party documentation describing what the sandbox covers, how to provision test data, or whether the API/MCP surfaces also support a sandbox mode. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/API docs, confirmation that sandbox mode covers the full API and MCP surface, and hands-on verification that sandbox calls do not affect production data.
